dashboard.label: TA-kernel Overview
dashboard.description: Collects kernel crash-readiness and crash signals: kexec crash kernel loaded, kdump service state, kernel taint state, uptime, and counts of NEW oops/panic/BUG lines in the kernel

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-kernel" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-kernel. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-kernel requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-kernel", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-kernel/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" | stats avg(uptime_s) as value | eval value=round(value/3600.0, 1)
index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" | stats avg(tainted) as value
index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" | stats avg(kdump_active) as value
index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" | stats avg(kexec_crash_loaded) as value

panel.title: Journal kernel-event scan - latest per host

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"oops_new\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=journal_readable | spath input=o path=bug_new | spath input=o path=oops_new | spath input=o path=panic_new | table host k journal_readable bug_new oops_new panic_new
